capabilities: Create drawings on a 1024x1024 bitmap canvas
Draw with a brush size slider and undo
Choose colors from the Flexoki palette
Save drawings as PNG files in a vault folder
disambiguation: Not the Canvas core feature for arranging notes on boards; it is a bitmap drawing pad whose output is saved as a PNG image.
extras: The manifest description notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create freehand drawings and embed them in notes.
summary: Drawing plugin that provides a minimal 1024x1024 bitmap canvas and saves drawings as PNG files in the vault.
